name: Unicorn Academy
description: When a dark force threatens to destroy Unicorn Island, a brave teen and her five schoolmates must rise up to protect their beloved magical academy.

videos.title: Unicorn Academy
videos.overview: At Unicorn Academy, regular teen Sophia has a lot to learn about fantastical creatures, but a dark force threatens to return and destroy unicorn magic!

videos.title: The Hidden Temple
videos.overview: While riding the Skyberry Trail, Wildstar gets spooked by grim magic, sending the group racing to a long-forgotten temple full of mysteries — and danger.

videos.title: The Race
videos.overview: Miss Primrose accelerates the students' training by sending them to an advanced obstacle course. But will competition get in the way?

videos.title: The Book of Grim
videos.overview: To learn more about grim magic, Sophia, Ava and Layla sneak into the library after hours to borrow a restricted book that proves to be too powerful.

videos.title: Under Starglow Lake
videos.overview: When grim magic contaminates the academy's water supply, the unicorns risk losing their power unless Sophia can save Starglow Lake with an unlikely ally.

videos.title: The Vision Pool
videos.overview: Eager to decode the message from the Whispering Willows, Sophia skips party planning to visit the Vision Pool — right after promising Ava she wouldn't.

videos.title: The Broken Gem
videos.overview: The Sapphires try everything to get Sophia and Ava to stop fighting, but they've got bigger problems: Two dastardly henchmen are after the grimstone.

videos.title: Ravenzella's Revenge
videos.overview: As the academy teachers gear up to battle a powerful foe, they forbid their students from leaving the dorms. But one rider doesn't follow the rules.

videos.title: Mended Hearts
videos.overview: Without the help of their teachers, the students must work together to take on the evil Ravenzella all by themselves. Unicorn Academy depends on it!

videos.title: Under the Fairy Moon
videos.overview: While gathering starburst flowers for the Fairy Moon ball, an accident breaks Isabel's trust in River, allowing a mysterious stranger to step in.

videos.title: Year of the Unicorn
videos.overview: On a Sapphire camping trip, a constellation that only appears every five years sends a special surprise down to Earth. But something troubles Wildstar...

videos.title: Star Showers
videos.overview: Ava throws a party for a foal that's been causing chaos around campus while Sophia investigates her father's connection to the Unicorn Constellation.

videos.title: Wildstar's Dream
videos.overview: Using a sleepover at the stables as their cover, the Sapphires sneak out in search of the crown stars. But they're not the only ones looking.

videos.title: Legacies
videos.overview: A legendary unicorn rider visits campus, stirring tensions between Sophia and Valentina. Layla gets jealous when Glacier reunites with an old friend.

videos.title: Mounting Pressure
videos.overview: Ms. Wildwood tasks the Sapphires with keeping wild unicorns safe from a volcano, which Sophia uses as an opportunity to search for another crown star.

videos.title: The Wrong Crowd
videos.overview: Sophia races to Starglow Lake to battle the Star Snatcher for the last crown star. Back at the dorms, Rory tries out for a secret society of pranksters.

videos.title: The Final Test (1)
videos.overview: For their final test, the students must infiltrate ogre-guarded ruins and rescue a hostage before the last bell rings... or risk immediate expulsion.

videos.title: The Final Test (2)
videos.overview: Working together unlocks a new bond for the Sapphire riders — and with it, new abilities. Then, Valentina comes clean to Sophia about the crown stars.

videos.title: Grimoria's Return
videos.overview: Sophia's good intentions lead to catastrophic events. Now the fate of Unicorn Island depends on the Sapphires — and the one test they dare not fail.

videos.title: Legendary Summer
videos.overview: When Layla makes a mistake over summer break that threatens all of the island's magic — and its unicorns — the riders saddle up to help set things right.

videos.title: Unicorn Academy Winter Solstice
videos.overview: It’s the most magical time of year at Unicorn Academy. Ava is pumped to show everyone the best solstice ever, but her plans get foiled by a pesky Solstice thief. Ride with Ava, Sophia, Layla, Isabel, Rory and Valentina and save the holiday for everyone!
